column1: # scripts/profiles.tsv: one row per skill, agent and MCP server the harness ships, saying when a project's facts make it active (SPEC-0004/D-1). Read through scripts/profiles.js, its one reader: `node scripts/profiles.js plan` prints what this clone's MEMORY.md selects.

# Columns, tab-separated: name: the skill's folder, the agent's file without .md, or the MCP server's key | kind: skill, agent or mcp | when: always, or tests joined by " and " and clauses joined by " or ", a test being <fact> = <value> or <fact> != <value>. A fact is a MEMORY.md label (Language, Frontend, Issue tracker, Runtime / package manager, ...) or Roles. A test compares the first word of each comma- or slash-separated item of the fact's value, ignoring case: Language = C# holds for "C# 13". A fact the project has not answered makes its test true, so a profile only ever narrows what a project has.
# Every skill, agent and server needs a row, as every vendored skill needs a licence row: an unclassified one stays active everywhere, and the harness tests fail until it has a row.
